author: Gaurav Kumar
content:
This experience is unacceptable and deeply frustrating — borderline unethical.

On 21st December 2025, I placed an order on Blinkit for Philips AC0950/60 Air Purifier, priced at ₹10,711. The delivery was completed in about 30 minutes, which initially seemed impressive.

However, after opening the package, I discovered that Blinkit had delivered Philips AC0920/60, which is a lower-end, cheaper, and inferior model. This product does not include a carbon filter, Wi-Fi capability, or app connectivity, all of which are standard and advertised features of the AC0950/60 model that I paid for.

The model I received sells for around ₹7,999, meaning I was overcharged by approximately ₹3,700. This is not a small mistake — it’s a serious product mismatch involving a significant amount of money.

When I tried to contact Blinkit support, the real nightmare began. Blinkit offers NO telephone customer support, forcing customers to rely entirely on chat support. The chat system is dominated by AI bots that repeatedly ask the same questions, lose context, and waste enormous amounts of time.

After nearly 40 minutes of back-and-forth, I finally connected with a human agent who provided no solution and simply asked me to wait 24 hours.

It has now been more than 24 hours, and I have received no follow-up, no update, and no resolution. To make matters worse, the original chat conversation has disappeared, so every new attempt requires repeating the entire issue from the beginning.

Blinkit’s model seems to prioritize speed over accuracy and completely fails when accountability is required. Fast delivery is meaningless if the wrong product is delivered and the company refuses or fails to resolve it.

I strongly advise against purchasing high-value or electronic items from Blinkit. If something goes wrong, there is no reliable support system to help you.

author: Partha Ghosh
content:
I ordered from BlinkIt on 3-Oct-2025 to my Kolkata address, but the order was wrongly delivered to Hyderabad (where we are usually registered). Despite the delivery address being marked clearly as Kolkata, BlinkIt staff called from Hyderabad.

When we objected, things got even worse. Customer support completely messed it up — manually cancelling orders, asking us to reorder, then cancelling again. This endless cycle of order → cancel → order → cancel went on for more than an hour, while my guests in Kolkata were waiting for food.

Not a single person at BlinkIt recognized the root problem. The software is dumb, not built to handle remote orders properly, and the support team is equally incompetent.

This is not the first time we’ve faced this issue when ordering in Kolkata while being stationed in Hyderabad. It’s an unacceptable flaw in BlinkIt’s system.

Overall: TERRIBLE, TERRIBLE experience. BlinkIt needs to seriously fix its technology and customer support before calling itself a reliable service.

author: Dishank Jain
content:
My recent experience ordering medicine through Blinkit in Noida was very disappointing.

Early in the morning I had severe loose motions and ordered a medicine that my family doctor had previously recommended and that has worked for me before. The app showed the medicine as available in stock, so I placed the order and added a few other items only to meet the minimum order / delivery criteria.

During the process I even spoke briefly with the consultation doctor and explained my symptoms before the call disconnected.

However, when the order arrived, the medicine was missing.

When I contacted customer support, I was informed that the medicine was not available and that a refund of ₹32 had already been initiated automatically.

The confusing part was that the medicine appeared in stock at the time of ordering, but support later mentioned different possibilities such as stock changing during dispatch.

Since the medicine was the primary reason for placing the order, the other items became unnecessary for me.

I live alone and was unwell at that moment, so the situation became quite frustrating.

The support executives were polite and tried to assist, but the final solution offered was only a refund, not a way to urgently get the medicine.

I hope Blinkit improves the stock accuracy and medical order handling process, because when people order medicines it is often an urgent health situation.

Sharing this experience so the company can hopefully improve the system for future customers.

title: Blinkit — Unreasonable Return Rejection
content: I am extremely disappointed with the response regarding my return request for the shoes I recently ordered from Blinkit. The shoes are extremely uncomfortable and feel very wobbly while walking, which can only be checked after actually wearing them. Your team rejected the return stating that the tag was removed. However, the “tag” was merely attached through a plastic thread, and that thread was only opened to check the comfort and fitting of the shoes. The actual tag is still safely with me. It was also a very disappointing experience speaking with your resolution team representative, Mr. Umar Farooq, over the phone. It is practically impossible for any customer to properly assess the comfort, stability, and walking experience of footwear without opening such a plastic thread and trying the shoes briefly. Also, if this policy is genuinely fair and customer-oriented, then the tags should ideally be attached separately to each shoe instead of both shoes being tightly connected together through a single plastic thread. When both shoes are completely tied together, how is any customer supposed to properly wear them and check the comfort, fitting, or walking experience before deciding whether the product is suitable or not? This condition is completely unreasonable for footwear products, where usability and comfort can only be evaluated after wearing them. content: Address: Gurugram, Plot No. 64 H, 18, Sector Rd, IOC Colony, IMT Manesar, India Website: www.blinkit.com Dear Blinkit Team, I am writing to express my deep frustration and disappointment with a recurring issue I have faced while ordering via the Blinkit app, specifically regarding the product "Kinder Joy Shaped Chocolates – Batwheels Edition". Naturally, I expected to receive the Batwheels edition, but once again, I received the Dinosaur version. I raised a complaint, and Executive Madiha contacted me. She confirmed that a replacement was available for the Batwheels edition and assured me that I would receive the correct product. I reconfirmed this with her, and she guaranteed it. Instead, I was again handed the same Dinosaur version. I contacted support again and spoke with Executive Shristi, who informed me that the third image on the product page states, “product may vary.” This explanation is not only irresponsible, but completely unacceptable. The product title and main image clearly highlight the Batwheels edition, and that is what any reasonable customer would expect to receive. Expecting customers to click through multiple images and interpret vague disclaimers to contradict the actual product title is not just poor design – it’s deceptive marketing. My Expectations: This experience has caused me unnecessary mental distress and has completely eroded my trust in your platform. Therefore, I am demanding the following: A full refund for both incorrect orders involving the Kinder Joy Batwheels edition. Compensation for the repeated inconvenience, false promises, time wasted, and mental harassment caused by your misleading advertisements and inefficient support. author: Anonymous
title: Blinkit — Customer experience matters: a recent challenge with blinkits refund process
content: Website: klicknoidaro.com As someone who often appreciates efficient services, I’ve always been impressed by Blinkit’s promise of delivering groceries in 10 minutes. It’s a game-changer when it comes to quick access to daily essentials. 🛒 However, my recent experience with their refund process has left me questioning their approach to customer service, especially when it involves returns or refunds for non-grocery items. I ordered an electronic product through Blinkit, but unfortunately, it turned out to be faulty. While Blinkit’s delivery is fast, their support system is quite the opposite. After returning the product on 14th October 2024, I was told that the refund would be processed within 3 working days. It’s been over 10 days now, and the refund of ₹999 is still pending. Despite several attempts to reach out through their app, I have received no satisfactory response. 📞 The Challenge: Blinkit doesn’t provide a direct customer support number or toll-free service, which makes it extremely difficult to address urgent issues. All communication happens through in-app support, which often results in repeated requests without real progress. 🚚 Why This Matters: A company that promises 10-minute deliveries should strive for the same efficiency when it comes to resolving issues and processing refunds. It’s not just about delivering fast, but also about supporting customers when things don’t go as expected. In contrast, platforms like Amazon and Flipkart excel in providing prompt and reliable customer service. They offer clear refund policies, direct communication channels, and transparency throughout the process — elements that are critical for building customer trust. I hope Blinkit takes this feedback into account and works towards improving their customer support system. After all, a great customer experience doesn’t end with delivery — it continues with how issues are handled afterward. Was this information helpful? No (0) Yes (4)
